PRIVACY & THIS PREVIEW

Your information.
Handled with clarity.

This notice describes the current review version of the Baanward website. Updated 17 September 2026.

The inquiry form is not connected

The preview form checks fields in your browser. It does not transmit entries to Baanward or store them in cookies, local storage or a website database. Use example information while reviewing it. Your browser may offer its own autofill or retain form entries under its settings.

Site access and technical information

The website itself does not add advertising, analytics, tracking cookies or third-party font requests. The hosting service may process request information, such as IP addresses and access logs, to deliver and protect the site. A hosted private preview may also use the platform’s sign-in and access controls, governed by that platform’s privacy terms.

What will be requested when inquiries open

The intended inquiry asks for your name, email, preferred communication method, property location and type, current stage, concern and optional relevant date or listing link. Do not submit deeds, identity documents, financial records or confidential legal files through the initial inquiry.

Specialist referrals

A Baanward inquiry is not a legal engagement. Permission must be obtained before information is shared for a referral. Walailak Law Firm carries out its own conflict checks and engagement process before receiving a substantive legal file.

Before live inquiry collection

The business must confirm the responsible operating entity, privacy contact, delivery provider, authorised recipients, storage location, retention period and procedures for information requests. This notice will be updated to reflect those arrangements before the form accepts submissions.
